Description
Only 2,500 of these unique coins exist! As the second in the American Pop Icons series, this 1 oz shaped Gorilla by Burton Morris is sure to sell fast! The work of Pop Artist Burton Morris comes to you in full color with the Burton Morris American Icons – Gorilla 1 oz Silver Coin. The artist, known by some as the modern day Andy Warhol, paints everyday objects in a bold, comic-like way, making statements about American popular culture.
This shaped and colorized 999.9 silver coin features the iconic King Kong climbing the Empire State Building, as interpreted by Morris in his piece entitled ‘Monkey Business’. The design showcases his signature vibrant palette and dark outlines, with a closer look at the details of the building in silver on the coin’s obverse adding contrast to this striking design. This 99.99% fine silver 1 oz collectible is produced by MKS PAMP exclusively and is available with a limited mintage of just 2500 coins available worldwide. The coin comes presented in themed packaging with a large window for display. Fans of Burton Morris and pop art will love this collectible. Fineness:.9999

Silver purity: 999.9
Reverse: Features a gorilla hanging from the Empire State Building.
Obverse: Niue coat of arms, along with serialization, assay, year and signature of Burton Morris. Sovereign coin issued by the government of Niue.
